title: Regular multigraph from a symmetric encoding
statement: Let $x$ be a Boolean list and let $n$ be a natural number. If the encoded edge relation is symmetric on vertices below $n$, the construction assigns a regular multigraph on the vertex set $\	ext{Fin}(n)$ of degree $2^{\operatorname{size}(n)}$.
hypotheses_covered: encoded edge relation is symmetric for all $u,v<n$
caveat: The endpoint construction is defined through upstream functions whose definitions are not included, so its precise edge multiplicities cannot be stated from the supplied material.
